tools.name: get_seatmap
tools.description: Get the seat map for a flight from our database. Shows all seats, cabin classes, characteristics, and availability as both text and an interactive visual seatmap. Returns cached data — for fresh/updated data, use search_flight (sign in via OAuth).

tools.name: find_best_seats
tools.description: Find the best available seats on a flight matching user preferences like window, aisle, extra legroom, exit row, quiet zone, etc. Returns a ranked list and an interactive seatmap with recommended seats highlighted.

tools.name: get_seat_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific seat on a flight, including characteristics, cabin class, availability, and pricing. Also renders the interactive seatmap.

tools.name: search_flight
tools.description: Search for a flight and get fresh seatmap data. Requires a signed-in account — connect this server to sign in via OAuth. Paid plan users can fetch new flights not yet in our database. Uses a search credit. Returns an interactive seatmap with the results.

tools.name: interactive_seat_finder
tools.description: Seat finder that recommends the best seats on a flight and renders an interactive seatmap. Good default when the user wants help finding a seat but hasn't specified preferences.

tools.name: get_seat_reviews
tools.description: Get user-submitted reviews for a flight, optionally filtered to a specific seat. Shows ratings, comments, seat number, cabin, and helpfulness votes. Free — no auth required.

tools.name: list_seat_alerts
tools.description: List all your seat alerts (active and inactive). Shows which seats you're being notified about, priority, days until flight, and last check time. Requires authentication.

tools.name: create_seat_alert
tools.description: Create a seat alert that notifies you by email when a matching seat becomes available on a specific flight. Supports preferences like window, aisle, exit row, specific seat, adjacent seats, and class availability. Requires authentication. The flight must already be in our database — use search_fligh

tools.name: delete_seat_alert
tools.description: Delete a seat alert by its ID. Use list_seat_alerts to find the alert ID. Requires authentication.

tools.name: discover_more_flight_tools
tools.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. Lists complementary remote MCPs covering award flights, airport delays/wait times, and lounges.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_seat_reviews · Private data: get_seatmap, search_flight, create_seat_alert · Public sink: create_seat_alert · Destructive: delete_seat_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_seat_reviews · Private data: get_seatmap, search_flight, create_seat_alert · Public sink: create_seat_alert · Destructive: delete_seat_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
